methods.name: public static boolean isFeatureSupported(@WebViewSupportFeature @NonNull String feature)
methods.comment:
* Return whether a feature is supported at run-time. This will check whether a feature is * supported, depending on the combination of the desired feature, the Android version of * device, and the WebView APK on the device. * *

Note: This method is different from * {@link WebViewFeature#isStartupFeatureSupported(Context, String)} and this method only * accepts certain features. Please verify that the correct feature checking method is used for * a particular feature. * *

Note: If this method returns {@code false}, it is not safe to invoke * the methods requiring the desired feature. Furthermore, if this method returns {@code false} * for a particular feature, any callback guarded by that feature will not be invoked. * * @param feature the feature to be checked * @return whether the feature is supported given the current platform SDK and WebView version

methods.name: public static boolean isStartupFeatureSupported(@NonNull Context context, @WebViewStartupFeature @NonNull String startupFeature)
methods.comment:
* Return whether a startup feature is supported at run-time. This will check whether a startup * feature is * supported, depending on the combination of the desired feature, the Android version of * device, and the WebView APK on the device. * *

Note: This method is different from * {@link #isFeatureSupported(String)} and this method only accepts startup features. Please * verify that the correct feature checking method is used for a particular feature. * *

Note: If this method returns {@code false}, it is not safe to invoke * the methods requiring the desired feature. Furthermore, if this method returns {@code false} * for a particular feature, any callback guarded by that feature will not be invoked. * * @param context a Context to access application assets This value cannot be null. * @param startupFeature the startup feature to be checked * @return whether the feature is supported given the current platform SDK and WebView version
